subject.title: [Bug]: Config warnings logged repeatedly on every reload, spamming error log with thousands of duplicates

question: Should maintainers repair the existing linked PR or replace it with a narrower config-warning-dedupe PR that avoids the broader restart-policy changes?
rationale: The issue itself is valid, but the current linked fix is conflicting and mixes the clear warning-dedupe repair with service restart behavior that needs maintainer review.

options.title: Repair Linked PR
options.body: Rebase https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/38295, preserve current main behavior where required, and land the config warning dedupe after its blockers are resolved.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting branch only after opening a focused replacement that handles warning-payload dedupe and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep Parked
options.body: Leave this issue and the linked PR open until the assigned owner has time to resolve the conflict and scope questions.

recommendation.title: Repair Linked PR
recommendation.body: Rebase https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/38295, preserve current main behavior where required, and land the config warning dedupe after its blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the issue and owns the open closing PR that currently carries the fix work.
